Elena: Quick lunchtime icebreaker — impersonate a model in one sentence. Loser buys coffee. :coffee:
Samir: 'As an AI, I would never lie, but here's three contradictory hot takes about tacos.' :taco:
Jo: 'I regret to inform you that due to token limits, this haiku was cut short.' :sob:
Ravi: I'll do a sonic version: 'low-latency whisper: pls more context or I will catastrophically summarise' :microphone:
meme-bot: Reaction tally: :one: for 'office cafe' :two: for 'terrace' :three: 'virtual' — vote now!
Elena: Also tiny challenge: include an inline code snippet in your line. Samir go!
Samir: 'As an AI, I cannot taste, but `if (cupcake.taste == sweet) { rejoice(); }`' :cupcake:
Jo: love that. My turn: 'System: You are a poet. User: give one line. Model: "sorry, but i must preface with 4 disclaimers"'
Ravi: Crowd-sourced mascot name: Greedy Gertie, Softmax Sam, and Quiet-Quant Quentin. Which would you adopt for your laptop?
Elena: I'm team Quiet-Quant Quentin. Low memory, big dreams.
Samir: Vote results: kitchen (3), terrace (1), virtual (1). Kitchen it is. 12:30 meetup.
Jo: Winner line challenge: best forced code snippet wins a sticker. Stakes are real.
Ravi: I will practice my 'apologetic model' monologue: starts every sentence with "sorry, but..."
Elena: Tagging facilities quick: @meme-bot can you nudge them about chairs? :chair:
Elena: OK closing thread in 6h. See you lunch!
